description: Find a person or project on Ethos when you only have a name, a partial handle or part of an address. Returns matching profiles with credibility score, status, linked wallets and social accounts, paginated. The starting point when a user asks about someone by name: search, pick the match, then score or profile it by userkey. Also useful for disambiguating impersonators from the real account. Free, no payment or key; the same answer as the free Ethos API. Example input: {"query":"vitalik","limit":"5"}. Example output: {"values":[{"id":32936,"profileId":1,"displayName":"Ethos","username":"ethos_network","avatarUrl":"https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/2074951227599646720/85k3GJ-s.jpg","score":2441,"status":"ACTIVE","userkeys":["profileId:1","service:x.com:1234567890","address:0x1234…"],"xpTotal":4076702,"influenceFactor":276,"stats":{"review":{"received":{"positive":120,"neutral":3,"negative":2}},"vouch":{"received":{"count":40}}}}],"total":1,"limit":5,"offset":0}

query.description: Name, handle or address fragment to search for.
